scenario: A lab used grant funds to buy a specialized centrifuge with a useful life of several years. The PI did not seek prior approval before the purchase.
policy: Equipment purchased with grant funds is defined as a tangible item with a useful life of more than one year AND a per-unit acquisition cost of $5,000 or more; such purchases require the funder's prior approval. Items below that threshold are supplies and need no prior approval.
question: Did this purchase require the funder's prior approval?
